items.name: hook_hi
items.direction: Narrate this in natural spoken Hindi, the way a popular Indian geography explainer YouTube Shorts channel talks. Numbers and English words are read in English. The Narrator is a deep, warm, confident storyteller: brisk and curious, punchy, urgent and surprised, like a scroll-stopping opener; leave a clear pause after the first question, a short comic pause before each punchline, quieter and serious for the invasion line. Chars voices a funny deadpan cartoon character, short and dry.
lines: क्या आप जानते हैं... नॉर्थ कोरिया और साउथ कोरिया आज भी जंग में हैं?
गोलियां nineteen fifty-three में रुक गईं... पर जंग कभी खत्म नहीं हुई।
